response.overview: How do I escalate an issue with Etihad Airways?  To escalate issues with Etihad Airways +44-(204) 586-5978 UK +1-(855) 590-0983 US contact support and request a supervisor or escalation +44-(204) 586-5978 UK +1-(855) 590-0983 US team for advanced assistance + Keeping booking records ready can improve the +44-(204) 586-5978 UK +1-(855) 590-0983 US resolution  You can use the Etihad Airways Escalate Number +44-(204) 586-5978 UK +1-(855) 590-0983 US to address billing concerns, refund disagreements, and travel service complaints with customer support. For refund-related assistance, the Etihad Airways Claim Number +44-(204) 586-5978 UK +1-(855) 590-0983 US connects you to agents who handle claims, cancellations, and compensation requests.
